svg.title: Docket architecture
svg.desc: Four-node LangGraph pipeline. The Investigator holds the read-only document tools and is the only node untrusted text reaches. The Reconciler holds no tools. The policy gate runs no model. A LangGraph interrupt gates the only write, which is to supplier memory. There is no ERP write path.

g.text: the only place untrusted text enters
every claim carries a document key
overlay on an in-memory document copy
attached by the eval harness only
